name: Grace Bay Club
positioning: Oceanfront resort on Grace Bay Road in Providenciales, split into a Hotel building for adults, family-friendly Villas Suites and the Estate
best_for: Couples who want to stay in a building reserved for adults
Families wanting the family-friendly Villas Suites and a kids program

facts.text: Grace Bay Club offers three distinct types of accommodation.
All three sections share oceanfront views and personal concierge service.
Infiniti Restaurant and Bar at Grace Bay Club is oceanfront.
The Grill's Friday Indian night serves curries and tandoori specialities in an oceanfront setting.
Grace Bay Club has a spa, a gym, a pool and a kids program.
Grace Bay Club is on Grace Bay Road in Providenciales.
Suites in the Hotel building use natural textures, soft tones and materials inspired by the island's landscape.
Grace Bay Club appeared in the Conde Nast Traveler Readers' Choice Awards in 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2022 and 2026.
Guests fly into Providenciales International Airport.

highlights.text: The Estate is a resort within a resort, with exclusive access to dedicated amenities such as a separate pool and cabanas.
The Hotel building is for adults, while the Villas Suites are family-friendly.
Each Friday evening, The Grill at Grace Bay Club becomes an Indian dining experience.
Infiniti serves fresh local fare such as a warm South Caicos lobster salad.
Grace Bay Beach offers calm, shallow waters suited to families and children.

considerations.text: The Turks and Caicos Islands can be affected by tropical weather between June and November.
Public transport on Providenciales is limited, especially in off-peak hours.
WhataHotel notes that the remote island location requires flight connections.
